transcript.content: Hello, what brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because for the last couple of years, I just feel low all the time. Like, even when I'm at work, or at church, or around people I care about, there's just this heavy, empty feeling. It just doesn't really ever lift.
During the past couple of years, have you had a period of two months or longer when you felt like your usual self?

No, not really. I mean... I can't remember a time like that. It's just been this same low feeling pretty much the whole time, without any real break. I definitely haven't felt like my usual self for two months straight.
During this period of feeling low, how has your energy level been?

It's been really low. Um... even small stuff, like filling out my inspection logs at work, or driving to basketball, or even just washing my hair... it all just feels like it takes way more energy than I actually have. And even when I try to just rest on my days off, it, um, it doesn't really refill me at all.
During this period, have you often felt hopeless about the future?

Um, no, not really. I wouldn't say I feel hopeless. I just feel really drained and low all the time, like I was saying, but I don't look at the future and think it's completely doomed or anything like that. I just haven't really noticed feeling hopeless.
During this same period, have you often had trouble sleeping or slept much more than usual?

Yeah, I definitely have trouble sleeping. Um, I’ll be completely exhausted after standing on the production floor all day, but when I finally get in bed, my mind just keeps running about everything I’m behind on. And then... if I do actually manage to fall asleep, I wake up feeling like I barely rested at all.
During this period, have you often lost interest in or gotten much less pleasure from things you usually enjoy?

No, I haven't really noticed that. I mean, I still like playing basketball and hanging out with my friends when I actually have the energy to do it. It's just... the energy part is the problem, not that I don't enjoy those things anymore. I still want to do them, I just feel too tired most of the time.
